newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai retail sales up 16.5 pct yr-on-yr in H1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai retail sales up 16.5 pct yr-on-yr in H1.

text.p: Shanghai's retail sales value reached 65.1 billion yuan ($7.84 billion) in the first half of 1997, an increase of 16.5 percent against the year-ago period after deducting inflation, the Business News said on Monday.
The overall profit margin of Shanghai's retail outlets rose 0.11 percentage points compared with the same period in 1996, the newspaper said.
Analysts said an expected growth in demand coupled with aggressive promotional activities were likely to see a further rise in retail sales value in the second half of 1997, it said.
